items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: I had that experience doing a show with a singer, a Billie Holiday show

ctx.x: who they were seeing and hearing. And it was just gorgeous. And the next day I got a call from him, he said, “What’s your address I want to send you something.” And in it was his book that’s the Smithsonian interviews. It’s a gorgeous book, color and so forth. With a good add: To Anne, thank you, Ron. He’s thanking me. So that’s how much the musicians love it.

It’s interesting you said that about sort of corralling the musicians and said, “Okay after this number then you have to go over here.” And I had that experience doing a show with a singer, a Billie Holiday show, and you know she would say, “After this thing you say this and then I’ll say this.” And I was going, “What do you mean?” It’s theater.
Yes. We could never get Phil Woods to come forward enough. We let him wear his hat as a crown but —
